mapper.select: SELECT dm.dm_id, SUM(CASE WHEN tdc.check_Person_Uid = #{uId} AND tdc.hf_Hg_Flag = '01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS hfHgCount, SUM(CASE WHEN tdc.check_Person_Uid = #{uId} AND tdc.measured_Flag = '01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS measuredCount FROM Drawing_Management_Catalogue dm LEFT JOIN task_distribution td ON td.dm_id = dm.dm_id LEFT JOIN task_distribution_check tdc ON tdc.td_id = td.td_id WHERE dm.p_id = #{pId} and td.state = 7 and (dm.del_flag <> '02' or dm.del_Flag is null) GROUP BY dm.dm_id
